what: Pressing the menu button grows a white panel, folded to 0×0 at the top-right corner of the screen with only the bottom-left corner heavily rounded (up to 300px), to 90vw × 98dvh (min 32rem) over .7s power4.inOut. .3s before it ends, the menu text appears over .5s. On close the text clears over .4s while the panel shrinks back to the corner on the same curve in .7s. Close by pressing the button, the panel, or Esc — a small company’s header bar where the menu panel blooms from a round button

options.dur: Duration of the panel growing and shrinking (s), default .7
options.fade: Duration (s) for the text to turn on, default .5 — starts .3s before the panel ends
options.close: Duration the text fades out on close (sec), default .4
options.[data-fx-part=toggle]: Toggle button — required. When open, the part element gets is-open
options.[data-fx-part=bg]: Growing white panel — must be present

note: Panel and text cell are fixed to the top-right of the screen by fx.css. The two button lines turning into an X is done by the user’s CSS with .is-open

from.where: shared.js .kh-drawer — menu drawer where a white panel grows out of a gradient ring button
